description: Search the AETumi COMMERCIAL CATALOG of licensable 3D web assets — Three.js / WebGL hero sections, 3D product viewers, shader backgrounds, scroll animations, React and Next.js components and full website templates. Returns a paged list, each item carrying id, title, category, industry, price and live demo url, plus a total and a pagination cursor. Use this when the user wants something to BUY, LICENSE AND SHIP. Do not use it for AETumi Labs reference experiences, which are not for sale — use find_experiences for those. To expand one result into full detail, follow with get_3d_web_asset. Read-only, no authentication, no side effects; returns public metadata.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous result.

limit.description: How many assets to return, 1-30, default 10.

query.description: Keywords describing the commercial asset wanted, e.g. hero 3d scene, product viewer, gradient background.

name: search_3d_web_assets

nextCursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page.

title: Search catalog assets
